introduction: ERC-7656 defines a factory for deploying services linked to any contract, including ERC-721 or ERC-1155 tokens and ERC-4337 smart accounts. It was proposed by Francesco Sullo in March 2024. Generalizing the token-bound account pattern of ERC-6551, the factory deploys each service as an ERC-1167 minimal proxy with the target chain ID, a mode selector, the linked contract, and an optional linked ID appended as immutable bytecode, giving every service a deterministic address computable before deployment.
designPurpose: ERC-7656 was designed to remove two limitations of earlier contract-linking schemes: they forced the deployed contract to behave as an account, and they supported only NFTs. Before it, giving a smart account or a token an owner-controlled helper contract meant building a separate registry for each case. By keeping the factory agnostic about the linked service's interface and adding a bytes12 mode selector, ERC-7656 offers one deployment and ownership model that serves NFTs, accounts, and future linkage patterns.
commonUsage: ERC-7656 is used to attach owner-controlled services to existing contracts without modifying them: social recovery, permission systems, and session keys for ERC-4337 accounts, or staking, dynamic metadata, and real-world-asset management for NFTs. Because a service's address derives deterministically from its implementation, salt, chain ID, mode, linked contract, and linked ID, wallets and indexers can reference a service before it is deployed and create it on demand when first needed.
fn.create.desc: Deploys a new linked service as an ERC-1167 minimal proxy of the given implementation, appending the chain ID, mode, linked contract, and linked ID as immutable data. Emits a Created event and returns the service address.
fn.create.params.implementation: The address of the service implementation the minimal proxy points to.
fn.create.params.salt: A salt value that lets multiple services share the same linkage parameters.
fn.create.params.chainId: The chain ID of the linked contract, appended to the service bytecode.
fn.create.params.mode: A bytes12 selector for the linkage type: LINKED_ID for token-linked services, NO_LINKED_ID for account-linked ones.
fn.create.params.linkedContract: The address of the contract or token the service is linked to.
fn.create.params.linkedId: The token or entity ID for LINKED_ID mode; set to zero when unused.
fn.create.returns.service: The address of the newly deployed linked service.
fn.compute.desc: Computes the deterministic address a linked service would have for the given parameters without deploying it. Returns the same address that create would produce.
fn.compute.params.implementation: The service implementation the proxy would point to.
fn.compute.params.salt: The salt value used in the address derivation.
fn.compute.params.chainId: The chain ID of the linked contract.
fn.compute.params.linkedContract: The address of the linked contract or token.
fn.compute.params.linkedId: The token or entity ID, or zero when unused.
fn.compute.returns.service: The deterministic address of the linked service.
fn.linkedData.desc: Returns the linkage parameters embedded in a linked service's bytecode. Services SHOULD implement this interface so callers can recover which contract a service is linked to.
fn.linkedData.returns.chainId: The chain ID of the linked contract.
fn.linkedData.returns.mode: The bytes12 mode selector recorded at deployment.
fn.linkedData.returns.linkedContract: The address of the linked contract or token.
fn.linkedData.returns.linkedId: The linked token or entity ID.
fn.Created.desc: Emitted by the factory when a new linked service is deployed, recording the service address and all linkage parameters.
fn.Created.params.contractAddress: The address of the newly deployed linked service.
fn.Created.params.implementation: The implementation the minimal proxy points to.
fn.Created.params.salt: The salt used for deterministic deployment.
fn.Created.params.chainId: The chain ID of the linked contract.
fn.Created.params.linkedContract: The address of the linked contract or token.
fn.Created.params.linkedId: The linked token or entity ID.
sim.createServiceWalkthrough.name: Create Linked Service
sim.createServiceWalkthrough.desc: Follow a create call from the deployer through minimal-proxy deployment to the Created event.
sim.createServiceWalkthrough.step.call: The deployer calls create() on the ERC-7656 factory, passing the service implementation, salt, chain ID, mode, linked contract, and linked ID.
sim.createServiceWalkthrough.step.deploy: The factory deploys the service as an ERC-1167 minimal proxy at a deterministic CREATE2 address derived from all of the parameters.
sim.createServiceWalkthrough.step.embed: The linkage parameters — chain ID, mode, linked contract, and linked ID — are appended to the proxy bytecode as immutable data that linkedData can read back.
sim.createServiceWalkthrough.step.event: The factory emits Created with the service address and linkage parameters so indexers can track the new linked service.
